nodes.name: Collection Request
nodes.notes: Webhook from legal-ops platform: {matter_id, collection_plan_id}. The collection plan is the counsel-approved scope; this flow executes against it, doesn't author it.

nodes.name: Per-Source Dispatch
nodes.notes: Fans out one item per (custodian, source) pair. The downstream switch routes by source.

nodes.name: Google Vault: Saved Query
nodes.notes: Creates a saved query in the matter; an export job is the next step (separate API call). Real production flow needs the full create-query → poll-export sequence; skeleton shown.

parameters.columns: matter_id, collection_id, custodian_id, source, plan_sha, collected_at, collected_by_service_account, hash, file_count, byte_count, scope_summary
